answer_1.quote: We cast PFCR as a ranking task. Specifically, given a post p and a set of fact-checked claims ... the goal is to rank the fact-checked claims so that c_p ranks as high as possible.

answer_2.quote: All are evaluated using Pair Success at 10 (S@10) and Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10). The former measures, for each post, whether the paired claim appears in the top-10 retrieved results, while the latter also considers its position.

answer_3.quote: We evaluate two re‑ranking techniques: cross‑encoder re‑ranking and LLM‑based re‑ranking ... LLM‑based re‑ranking ... harnessing the reasoning capabilities of the underlying model.
